name: scholialang
description: Local Scholialang tracing with default per-project auto-emit and reference tools for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Scholialang adds local MCP tools for project-aware trace capture, compact summaries, search, export, and reference lookup. It stores traces on your machine and helps Codex retrieve small summaries instead of repeatedly carrying full work history in context.
defaultPrompt: Start a Scholialang trace for this project.
Search my Scholialang traces for decisions.
